attractions.name: Aso Rock
attractions.address: Three Arms Zone, Central Business District, Abuja
attractions.description: A massive 400-metre monolith overlooking the capital, and one of the most recognizable natural landmarks in Nigeria.

attractions.name: Nigerian National Mosque
attractions.address: Independence Avenue, Central Business District, Abuja
attractions.description: The national mosque of Nigeria, with a gold dome and four minarets, standing near the National Christian Centre as a symbol of religious coexistence.

attractions.name: National Christian Centre
attractions.address: Independence Avenue, Central Business District, Abuja
attractions.description: The ecumenical centre serving as Nigeria's national house of worship for Christians, known for its striking dome and cross.

attractions.name: Millennium Park
attractions.address: Cadastral Zone A00, Central Business District, Abuja
attractions.description: Abuja's largest public park, designed by an Italian architect, with landscaped gardens, arch bridges, and open lawns for relaxing or walking.

attractions.name: Jabi Lake
attractions.description: A scenic reservoir surrounded by restaurants, a boardwalk, and boat rides, popular for evenings and weekend outings.

attractions.name: Zuma Rock
attractions.address: Along Abuja-Kaduna Expressway, Niger State (near Abuja)
attractions.description: A dramatic 725-metre monolith just outside the city, often called the 'Gateway to Abuja' and featured on the old 100-naira note.

attractions.name: Wonderland Amusement Park
attractions.address: Independence Avenue, Central Business District, Abuja
attractions.description: A family-friendly amusement park with a Ferris wheel, rides, and games, located next to Millennium Park.

attractions.name: MKO Abiola National Stadium
attractions.description: Nigeria's national stadium, home to major football matches and athletics events, with seating for over 60,000 spectators.
